notes.title: Version 0.1.14-alpha
notes.content: [h2]Map Changes[/h2][list][*][p]Several existing rooms within the facility have been revamped, and a few new ones have been introduced. (Please note many of these rooms are still very much so work-in-progress. Feedback on them is appreciated!)[/p][/*][*][p]Breakable Glass has been introduced in some of these rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]A new vertical door type has been introduced.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Physics Props[/h2][list][*][p]Over 100 new physics props have been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]These props can be found around the facility, or spawned via a menu in the admin panel.[/p][/*][*][p]Some props can be damaged and destroyed (currently only the explosive barrel.)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Main Menu Redesign[/h2][list][*][p]The main menu is now in an office setting, with the server list and options displayed on a monitor.[/p][/*][*][p]Please note the design is not final, we just wanted to get this done quickly for the playtest.[/p][/*][/list][h2]SCP-173 Redesign[/h2][list][*][p]SCP-173 has received a new model and sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay changes will be coming in a future update.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Item Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Keycard ranks have been revamped, and more of them can be found around the facility. (Mainly LCZ.)[/p][/*][*][p]The Medkit has received a new model.[/p][/*][*][p]Grenades are red now.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now aim with the Short Range SMG.[/p][/*][/list][h2]New Sounds & Music[/h2][list][*][p]HCZ and LCZ doors have received new sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Tesla Gates have received powerful new zapping sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]The Short Range SMG and Pistol have received new gunshot sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]All SCPs (except 457) have received stingers and chase themes.[/p][/*][*][p]Surface Zone has a new ambient track.[/p][/*][*][p]MTF have a new spawn wave theme.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.12-alpha
notes.content:
- Networking fixes
- Fixed voice chat for SCP-173

notes.title: Version 0.1.11-alpha
notes.content:
- Updated the map editor
- Updated surface zone
- Added some room blockouts in HCZ
- Attempted to improve performance
- Fixed items not being throwable

notes.title: 0.1.10-alpha
notes.content:
- Updated surface zone blockout
- - Now there is a nuke control room
- Remove the texture scaling code
- - It was causing too many issues, and didn't work very well
- SCPs activate tesla gates again
- Fix sticky grenades sticking to the thrower

notes.title: 0.1.9-alpha
notes.content:
- Fixed thrown sticky grenades
- Fixed some item-related networking bugs

notes.title: 0.1.8-alpha
notes.content:
[p]- Added a door that was missing at NTF spawn
- Fixed a few bugs with doors and thrown keycards
- Improved thirdperson animations (again)
- Removed some recoil from the P90/Short range rifle
- Sticky grenades can now stick to players
- - Just grab a stuck grenade to remove it from someone
Known Issues:
- Sticky grenades visually disappear when thrown.

notes.title: 0.1.7-alpha
notes.content: - Fixed positions and rotations being invalid for synced objects

notes.title: 0.1.6-alpha
notes.content:
- Added Steam Timeline Support
- Added Sticky Grenade
- Adjusted liquid simulation
- Steam not running warning doesn't open when running a dedicated server
- Updated the playermodels to support complex animation blending
- Added a non-weapon playermodel animation
- Added/Unlocked SCP-895's chamber
- - Contains some item spawns
- - SCP-895 is not in game as of right now
- Update required keycard access for checkpoints and gates
- Updated some viewmodels
- Fixed escape/menu not closing certain menus
- Added new gunshot sounds, which sound different at certain distances
- Updated Surface Zone block-out
- Removed inspect viewmodel animations playing at random
- Possibly fix SCP-049 being killed at spawn
- Fixed viewmodel sounds being cut off
- Flashlights can now be toggled off and on
- Updated graphics settings
- - Shadows are now a single dropdown
- - Texture size limit is now pre-loaded before playing the game (this setting can only be changed from the main menu now)
- Added a loading screen when the game starts or the texture size limit is changed

notes.title: 0.1.5-alpha
notes.content:
- Changed a bunch of damage multipliers
- - SCP-049-2 deals much more damage
- Added blood particles when shooting people
- Fixed SCP-914 not working in some cases
- - Note that SCP-914 still doesn't do much besides upgrade keycards
- Fixed the grab icon appearing on other players items
- Added SCP-207
- - Grants a temporary speed boost, but degrades health over time
- Fixed the intercom not working
- Disable D3D12 being a fallback from Vulkan
- - If you wish to run the game with D3D12, use the launch option `--rendering-driver d3d12`
- - If you wish to run the game with OpenGL3, use the launch option `--rendering-driver opengl3`
- Fixed the inputs menu not letting you scroll

notes.title: v0.1.4-alpha
notes.content:
- New LCZ Airlock Room
- Game version will be outputted to logs now (mainly to help us debug issues)
- Increase max render-able items
- Fix some issues with lip sync blend shapes
- Disabled OpenGL3 Fallback
- Enabled (somewhat buggy) D3D12 rendering (disabled by default)
- - Note that this seems to hard crash your PC if you have buggy DirectX 12 drivers (Intel Arc B-Series crashes, NVIDIA 30 Series doesn't seem to, AMD is untested)
- Updated movement for stairs
- - This fixes the "surfing on walls" bug
- Fixed some bugs with teleporting and fall damage (hopefully)
- Added a test NPC. Can be spawned with the command "SpawnNPC <player id>"

notes.title: 0.1.3-alpha
notes.content:
Guns deal more damage now, and there is a new prototype of Surface Zone!

- Updated gun stats
- Updated hitbox stats
- Surface Zone has been replaced with a new prototype version
- Fixed a few voice chat bugs with spectators and alt. voice chat
- Updated some props
- Fixed spectator freecam on death
- Re-enabled depth prepass when rendering (should improve performance with tons of small, obstructed items)
- Fixed some issues with large amounts of network traffic
- Fixed security cameras not updating when pressing use on them
- SCP-106 can walk through props
- SCP-049 can pick up props
- SCP-049-2 can hit props forward
- SCP-173 can run into props and hit them at high speed
